pitch.subject: A packing challenge with our carry-on bags
pitch.body: Hi Mira, we make carry-on bags for budget travelers and would love to co-create a 30-day packing challenge with your community. We can cover prizes and production.

promote: Guides made by people in my community

voice: Posted a new Lisbon guide today. Short, no fluff, every price dated. If you try it, tell me what I got wrong.
Going alone is scary. Do it anyway.

content.reply: Hi Lena, thanks for this. A beginner-friendly challenge is close to what I care about, as long as it helps people pack lighter rather than just sell bags. Could you share what the 30 days would look like and how my fans would be involved? Then I'll get back to you.
